name: Renewal & coverage gaps
lead: Before the renewal date, the renewal offer is compared clause by clause with the expiring policy and the client's updated situation. What got worse, what is missing and what changed shows up before anyone signs.

project.title: Jan 1, 2027 renewal of the commercial package for Birchwood Joinery Ltd (fictional)

extracts.text: Insured location: workshop, 12 Tanner Street, Ashby Vale (fictional).
Since September we rent a 300 m2 warehouse in Millbrook (fictional) for our timber stock.
CNC machining centre bought in June 2026 ($150,000). Total equipment: $560,000.
Excluded: non-physical loss arising from a cyber attack.
Exclusions: war, intentional acts, wear and tear. No cyber attack exclusion.

steps: Reading the expiring policy and the renewal offer
Checking against the client fact sheet and recent emails
Coverage gaps and questions for the insurer

fields.label: Machinery sum insured declared
fields.hint: Value taken from the renewal offer

checks.label: Machinery sum insured at least the real equipment value ($560,000)
All client locations insured (2)
checks.ko: {sites} location declared for 2 locations in use

checks.label: Client meeting before the notice deadline (Oct 31, 2026)
checks.ko: Meeting on {date_client}: after the notice deadline

output.title: Renewal review: client note, draft
output.sub: Each change shows the expiring clause and the renewal clause.

items.t: The water damage deductible goes from $500 to $1,500, for a 2% higher premium.
New exclusion of non-physical loss from a cyber attack (absent from the expiring policy).
The warehouse rented since September is not an insured location: {sites} location(s) declared.
Machinery sum insured declared: {capital}, against $560,000 of equipment since the CNC purchase. Underinsurance risk.
Revenue up from $1,300,000 to $1,700,000: to declare for liability and business interruption.
Keep the water damage deductible at $500, or justify the increase.
Add the Millbrook warehouse and raise the machinery sum insured to $560,000.
Offer separate cyber cover if the exclusion stays.
Client meeting on {date_client}, before the notice deadline.
Re-market the risk if the insurer declines: [TO DECIDE with the client].

contradictions.title: Water damage deductible tripled
contradictions.impact: Cover gets worse while the premium goes up.
contradictions.action: Negotiate, or tell the client in writing.

contradictions.title: Uninsured location: the warehouse rented in September
contradictions.impact: A loss at the warehouse would not be covered.
contradictions.action: Have the location added before renewal.

contradictions.title: Machinery sum insured too low
contradictions.impact: Underinsurance: the claim payment would be reduced proportionally.

contradictions.title: New cyber exclusion
contradictions.action: Inform the client and propose a solution.
